cargo_temp.scored_pallet_note: Scoring uses the REAR pallet: the warmest position on average, so it spoils first.
cargo_temp.inputs_note: v1 has no outside-weather input for cargo temperature; refrigerated trucks (reefer) only.
cargo_temp.source: notebooks/02_cargo_temp_model.ipynb, model M2 (linear regression: pallet + days in transit) refit on all 6 shipments

shelf_life.interpolation: linear between neighbouring points: days = d0 + (temp - t0) * (d1 - d0) / (t1 - t0)
shelf_life.outside_range: clamp: below 0 C use the 0 C value, above 30 C use the 30 C value (the study tested 0-30 C only)
shelf_life.source: Yan et al., 'Effect of Different Storage Temperature on Respiration Rate and Quality of Strawberry', Journal of Refrigeration (制冷学报), Issue 5, pp. 37-42

delay.source: FHWA Road Weather Management Program, https://ops.fhwa.dot.gov/weather/roadimpact.htm (rain, heavy_rain, fog = range midpoints; snow, ice, thunderstorm = project assumptions)

rules.delay: for each stretch between neighbouring points: planned_min = eta[i+1] - eta[i] in minutes; use the WORSE bucket of the two ends (larger speed_reduction); extra_min = planned_min * (time_factor - 1). predicted_delay_min = sum of extra_min, rounded to 1 decimal.
rules.steps: split predicted_total_duration_min, starting at departure, into 15-minute steps; the last step is shorter if the total is not a multiple of 15
rules.step_temperature: cargo temperature of the scored pallet at the START of each step: days_since_departure = step_start_min / 1440
rules.shelf_life: remaining = 100 * (1 - sum over steps of step_hours / (shelf_life_days(step_temperature) * 24)), floored at 0; shelf life starts at 100% at departure
rules.rounding: round every output to 1 decimal, half to even on the exact double value (Python round(); Java: new BigDecimal(x).setScale(1, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN))
